name: Loongson Technology Corporation Limited
summary: Loongson Technology Corporation Limited engages in the research, development, production, sale, and service of processor chips in China. The company offers processors, such as IT systems, industrial control embedded system, and loongson companion chip. It also provides Loongnix operating system that offers services for personal computers, servers, and cloud computing in the generalized informatization field; LoongOS, an industrial control operating system; Loongson Browser; and firmware.
